title: Family with Girls Under Palm Tree, Shadows - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A backlit vintage snapshot depicting two women and two young girls standing outdoors on a grassy lawn in front of tall trees and a large palm tree. The subjects are dressed in mid-century day dresses and short-sleeved frocks, casting long, dramatic shadows forward across the sunny lawn. The photograph features decorative deckled edges typical of mid-20th-century family photo processing.
